sentences.text: The assumption that RBI has capped penal charges at 2% is not supported by the in-force UCB directions, which say no upper limit or cap for penal charges has been prescribed.

The current UCB directions instead require penal charges, if charged, to be treated as penal charges and not as penal interest, and they must not be levied on the earlier outstanding amount of penal charges.
Your bank’s sanction letters state penal charges of 1% per annum on the amount in default for the period of default, with no interest computed on penal charges.
